HRA Analysis: GREASED LIGHTNIN (7) was taken back and to the pegs last time out from a wide draw and looked to have a big task ahead of him there getting into the money. He was able to flash home late into fourth running home a quick last half in a race taken out by Always B Cool who is a very smart horse on the rise. He has high speed and despite the wide draw looks to have strong claims in this race. DRAGON (6) sat behind the leader two starts ago and was able to run a good second behind Tiger Band Wagon. He should find this race a bit easier but does draw quite awkwardly and may be shuffled back or forced to do some work in the run. STARZZZ DESTINY (3) finished a very close up sixth last time out at this track and trip when badly held up for clear running late. He draws favourably in this race and should be able to press forward and find a prominent position in the early stages. He should run well again. SPUNKYSGOTSECRETS (4) caught the eye recently when flashing home into second after being badly held up at a crucial stage in a race taken out by Flying Colours. He draws a touch awkwardly in this race and may be forced to do some work but is racing well and should run another good race. SELECTIONS: GREASED LIGHTNIN (7), DRAGON (6), STARZZZ DESTINY (3), SPUNKYSGOTSECRETS (4) SUGGESTED BET: GREASED LIGHTNIN (7) to win.

LEAP TO FAME (7) will likely use this race as another stepping stone towards his trip to NZ to tackle and attempt to conqueror the NZ Cup. He draws widest but shouldn’t have any issue overcoming the draw and was ultra impressive when first up sitting outside of Captain Shuffles and simply proving far too good at this track and trip. He should be able to work forward to the lead in this race and he will be winning again. DASHING (10) was a very impressive second placing in his last race start behind the champion LEAP TO FAME (7) when beaten just 3.1m. He has since won a trial recently and is likely to have derived benefit from the outing. He looks likely to get a lot less favours in the run this time drawn outside back row over the mile but has been racing particularly well and should be running on late. FOR REAL LIFE (1) returns in this race with an ideal draw to be able to drive through and hold a prominent position in this race. He trialled well recently when running third to his stablemate French Fries following the helmet of Sinabun right to the line appearing to travel strongly there. He should get every chance to run into the placings on return. HECTOR (8) trialled up nicely recently when finishing second to Dashing in a trial they just dashed home up the straight. He looks likely to get a good run through early and settle close to the speed and looks a horse which could add good value to the exotics. SELECTIONS: LEAP TO FAME (7), DASHING (10), FOR REAL LIFE (1), HECTOR (8) SUGGESTED BET: HECTOR (8) to place.

GUS (10) the Inter Dominion Trotting champion of 2026 returns in this race and faces a big 50m handicap in this race which is likely to put him to the rest first up. His latest trial was very impressive beating pacer Betterthan Popsy by a big margin and was able to dash up a quick last quarter of 26.7. He will look to run well in this race before looking towards repeating his 2025 NZ successes. KEAYANG STUKA (9) has a key 20m handicap advantage on main rival GUS (10) in this race which he is likely to be keen to hold in the early stages of the race. He comes into this race third up from a spell off the back of a good run second up when finishing a close up second to PINNIE (8) who he takes on again in this race. PINNIE (8) has been impressive since joining the stable of Chantal Turpin scoring another good win last time out when working to the lead before holding off the late challenge of KEAYANG STUKA (9). She is versatile and with a safe beginning from her 30m handicap she should run well in this race. MAJESTIC LAVROS (1) stepped nicely last time out to lead before handing over and was able to hang on for third there behind Pinnie and Keayang Stuka. He should be able to step to the lead again in this race before waiting for one of the more fancied runners to hand over to and he can run well again from there. SELECTIONS: GUS (10), KEAYANG STUKA (9), PINNIE (8), MAJESTIC LAVROS (1) SUGGESTED BET: GUS (10) to win.

DUAL CAM (3) has good gate speed and can look to work forward and find the lead in this race. He sat outside the leader at Kilcoy two starts ago and was a dominant winner there racing right away late to win by 23.1m. He then had much less luck last time out when getting back and couldn’t get into the race late which was taken out by Sweet Lad Jujon. He should be hard to beat. SWEET LAD JUJON (8) impressed last time out when leading early before handing over and was able to sprint up powerfully to score a stylish win over the 2138 at this track. He draws inside the back row this time and will need luck at the right time but could be suited by a step back to the 1660. NEXT TO ME (6) led early before handing over to the classy Fire And Passion over the 2138 at this track and he was able to battle away for a good second there. He draws less favourably this time but could appreciate the step back to the shorter journey and will find this race a lot more suitable. MAYWYN TROUBADOUR (1) took on a weaker race last time out where he sat without cover and battled on nicely for third behind Splashndash. He has good gate speed and can lead before looking for something to follow and he should run well from there. SELECTIONS: DUAL CAM (3), SWEET LAD JUJON (8), NEXT TO ME (6), MAYWYN TROUBADOUR (1) SUGGESTED BET: DUAL CAM (3) to win.

FATE AWAITS (1) draws ideally in this race and looks set to go around a very short priced favourite following another impressive win last time out sitting without cover and beating his stablemate Ruby Rules. He should be able to lead in this race and will take plenty of running down. MOSTERT (3) was able to find the front last time out taking them all the way beating his stablemate Williams rating fast time. He looks set to be forced to do some work this time and steps out to the longer journey for the first time in QLD which both look queries. MOSSDALE TERRY (8) looks set to get an ideal run through in this race behind the likely leader and favourite FATE AWAITS (1). He led two starts and was beaten by a horse who has been impressive this time in Air Express. He should get every chance to run into the placings again in this race. FRENCH FRIES (5) trialled up well recently when beating Sinabun and his stablemate For Real Life who is set to take on the FFA earlier in the card. He draws awkwardly in this race and may need a few things to go his way in the run but does have plenty of ability. SELECTIONS: FATE AWAITS (1), MOSTERT (3), MOSSDALE TERRY (8), FRENCH FRIES (5) SUGGESTED BET: MOSSDALE TERRY (8) to place.

WILLIAMS (5) has been very impressive this campaign running and may have put in his best run yet last time out when sitting without cover and running a big race finishing second to his stablemate Mostert who rated a fast mile rate of 1.50.4. He looks likely to be able to work to the lead in the early stages of this race and should be very hard to run down from there. HES ALL TORQUE (1) has good gate speed and should be able to lead before handing over to the likely short priced favourite WILLIAMS (5). He led early last time out before handing over to Mostert and was able to hang on for a good third there. He should get every chance to run into the placings again. GEM PUNTER PETE (8) should get a good run through early in this race behind a gate speed horse in this race. He raced without luck last time out when getting a long way back off the pegs and was running on late in a race which was dominated by runners up on speed on the pegs. TENACIOUSLY (3) moves in a spot closer as a result of O B LEGAL (2) being made ODM following an early error on Tuesday which sees her set to begin from a draw she will not need to do any work to land in the running line. She finished close up last time out in strong mares company in a race taken out by Ruby Rules over Cool And Classy. SELECTIONS: WILLIAMS (5), HES ALL TORQUE (1), GEM PUNTER PETE (8), TENACIOUSLY (3) SUGGESTED BET: WILLIAMS (5) to win.

FIRE AND PASSION (7) impressed recently at this track when zipping across early and winning by a big margin over lesser opposition. He draws widest in a much tougher race but is a high quality horse and is likely to be nearing peak fitness in this race third up from a spell. BARRACUDA (4) was able to lead last time out of the 1660 at this track and was able to lead all the way there beating Bonnies Cam. He will be looking for his fourth consecutive win in a row in this race and draws reasonably in this race. With the right run he should be hard to beat again despite the step up in class. BITE THE EAR MIKE (5) was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well there for third behind Williams and FIRE AND PASSION (7). He draws a touch awkwardly in this race and may be shuffled back or forced to do the work early. SURREAL MORAN (1) draws well on return in this race off the back of a trial where he ran a well beaten second to Move It Lou. He is likely to have derived a lot of benefit from his recent outing at the trials and draws ideally in this race. SELECTIONS: FIRE AND PASSION (7), BARRACUDA (4), BITE THE EAR MIKE (5), SURREAL MORAN (1) SUGGESTED BET: FIRE AND PASSION (7) to win.

DEBBIE LINCOLN (4) was able to show good gate speed recently to find the front taking them all the way there beating Isla Rochelle and rating good time. She looks likely to be able to find the front again in this race and with a better draw than her key rivals she looks hard to beat. RUBY RULES (7) has been excellent recently since returning from a spell. She was very good two starts ago beating her stablemate Cool And Classy before backing that up with another good run finishing second to Fate Awaits. She may be forced to do the work but is up to it off recent efforts in a race of this nature. TREMENDOUS SENSATION (5) led two starts ago and was run down late by Seaside Glory who had the perfect run on her back and was able to dash past her late up the sprint lane. She should get a reasonable run off the speed in this race and can run into the money again. SALLY BIGTIME (6) led early last time out before eventually handing over the lead and battled on well enough there for third. She draws quite awkwardly in this race and will need a lot to go her way from the wide draw to be figuring in the finish again. SELECTIONS: DEBBIE LINCOLN (4), RUBY RULES (7), TREMENDOUS SENSATION (5), SALLY BIGTIME (6) SUGGESTED BET: DEBBIE LINCOLN (4) to win.

THE LADY DIOR (3) draws well in this race and can look to press forward and find the lead in the early stages of the race. She sat without cover last time out and was very good there battling on for third in a race the winner Bettors Moon rated fast time leading all the way. DOLLY ROCKET (7) was able to secure the right type of run on the pegs last time out before finishing it off powerfully into second in a race taken out by Tizzy Lizzie. She draws much less favourably this time and will need the race run to suit but is capable of running on in this type of race. SPORTY ZARA (1) was restrained at the start last time out after drawing a touch awkwardly before ending up at the rear of the field and was forced to make a run widest on the track in a race taken out by Tizzy Lizzie. She put in a good run there making up late ground and should get a good run from the ideal draw in this race. SHES IN LINE (2) was able to lead early last time out before relinquishing the lead to Bettors Moon and was able to run a good second there behind that horse in a race the winner rated good time over the 1660 at this track. She should settle close enough again from a good draw in this race and should get her chance. SELECTIONS: THE LADY DIOR (3), DOLLY ROCKET (7), SPORTY ZARA (1), SHES IN LINE (2) SUGGESTED BET: SPORTY ZARA (1) each way.

AARDIES A STAR (2) draws the best of the main chances in this race and can look to press forward early and find the lead. He returned recently with a nice trial win beating Wave Of Delight and dashing up a nice last quarter of 27.3. He should be hard to beat in this race. BETTER ONE (4) returned last time out when getting back and powering into second late making a very wide run into it in a race taken out by BLACKJACK SAM (5). He is likely to have derived a lot of benefit from the outing and should settle closer this time from a more favourable draw. BLACKJACK SAM (5) found the front last time out at this track and trip and was able to take them all the way scoring an easy win over stablemate BETTOR ONE (4). He looks to draw a touch awkwardly this time and may be forced to do some work in the run. HARRY THE HAT (6) draws poorly in this race and is likely to be shuffled back in the early stages. He was able to score a nice win last time out finding the front and dashing home nicely to beat stablemate Fan The Flame at this track and trip. SELECTIONS: AARDIES A STAR (2), BETTER ONE (4), BLACKJACK SAM (5), HARRY THE HAT (6) SUGGESTED BET: AARDIES A STAR (2) to win. SISTER PATRICK (12) has a tricky handicap to overcome but she has a massive motor. She was a winner first up at Gawler last start and she looks like a big threat tonight if she can trot smoothly and receive some luck. NOTHING I WANT (2), STAR OF PATRICK (6) and NO REMORSE (5) are all big threats in what is a very even race.

CLARENDEN TRIBUTE (5) has won three of his last five starts and is racing in some career best form. He finds a winnable race again tonight and he should travel well for Gaita Pullicino. RANGER RICK (1), ROCKNROLL SPIRIT (3) and IM ALL BUSINESS (11) are also chances.

ROCKIN GEMMA (4) was very impressive when she took out The Radiant at Port Pirie a few weeks back. She had a tough run in a heat of the SA Cup last week. She gets an ideal draw tonight and if she can get a quiet run and sprint home she will be hard to beat. CEE CEE LOU (3) is another who is racing well and he looks like a massive danger after a strong run in his heat of the SA Cup last week. HEZROCKINROYALTY (7) and FLY THE BANNER (2) are also chances.

CASTERTON (10) has won two of his three career starts. He was a dominant winner in his heat of the Golden Nursery last start when he defeated ONE AUSSIE by 8.6 metres. He will be extremely hard to beat tonight in the final. JADES REASON (1) was extremely tough last week when she was eventually run down by RANKINE. She will be a threat tonight from the inside draw. RANKINE (8) is undefeated so far and looks like a danger tonight even though tonight will be a lot tougher. KOJAX (6) looks the next best.

LUVTOBEUPTOME (4) was so impressive last week when he showed off his 400 metre sprint to defeat MAJOR BLITZ by 6.6 metres and ran a mile rate of 1.55.7. His last quarter of 26.6 was electric. It will take a major effort to beat him tonight. ZANDA MAN (8) didn’t work into it last week but he has the ability to feature tonight if he can receive some luck. MAJOR BLITZ (10) was another who was a bit disappointing last week but he can improve majorly tonight. STEAM MACHINE (1) looks the next best.

The main event for the evening and on the SA harness racing calendar. THE LAST TRIP (3) is well drawn tonight after his track record breaking run last week when he defeated HAPPY TOO YA by 8.6 metres and ran a mile rate of 1.55.5. It’s really hard to not see him getting beaten tonight. ULTIMATE VINNIE (1) will love the inside draw and he was tough last week when he led all of the way to defeat ABOUTTIME by 2.7 metres. SPRINGFIELD AFFAIR (5) and FORTY LOVE (6) are also big chances.

The Trotters Cup field has plenty of depth but there isn’t a lot of reliable form lines to go off. THE VICARS GIRL (10) was very disappointing in her runs leading up to her heat win last start. She defeated MORE WANTED by 3.9 metres in her heat after facing the breeze for a lot of the race. She has a lot of talent and if she can produce her best run tonight she should be hard to beat. ARTIGAS (1) will be a major threat tonight if he can step away cleanly from the stand start. REGAL ATTIRE (13) and BITTA IRISH LUCK (7) are also chances.

JAWSOFGOODTIME (1) has won her last two starts leading all of the way. She defeated ASHANTE PRINCE by 2.7 metres last start. It’s really hard to see her getting beaten tonight if she is at her best. FEARFULL DRAGON (8), ROCKAMARA (5) and WHATA OPTIMIST (11) are also chances.

CHASE THE STARS (4) ran two very good races in The Radiant series at Port Pirie a few weeks back. Tonight he finds a very winnable race and is a good chance of finding the lead. ASHANTE PRINCE (3), NORMY (1) and RUFF NUT (7) are also chances.

TUFFASNAILS (2) meets a tricky field tonight but his last two wins have been very impressive. If he can lead tonight he should be very hard to catch. KITTYKAT CUTIE (7) ran a very tidy race last start when she defeated NIGHT SPIRIT by a metre. She got a great run into the race but still sprinted very hard and looked magnificent hitting the line. She is a big threat again tonight. TWIN CONNECTION (3) and NIGHT SPIRIT (1) are also massive threats. Well we kick off a very tricky meeting with a very tricky two year old trotters race. LUSTROUS (6) has been trialling well at Port Pirie and does have the one race start under his belt. If he can trot smoothly today he should be right in the mix. VALLERY (3), NORTHBOUNDBUSINESS (2) and CASH ME UP (4) are also chances.

BROOKIES BABE (2) is no stranger to winning from the stand start. She is drawn off the front today and if she steps away cleanly and leads she will be quite hard to catch. BUCKLES (6), EMILY MEAGAN (4) and LOW LIE THE FIELDS (5) could all be big improvers today.

WEREGOINGTOGETCHA (1) gets a favourable draw today from the inside. She is a strong chance of holding the lead today and bouncing back into the winners list. This is her sort of race. SNEAKY PHILTRA (6) has a good record here at Globe Derby. Her stable and her driver must be respected. PERFECT PLAYGIRL (5) and FLYIN TOMMY (2) are also chances.

KOJAX (5) is a two year old up against the older horses today. He has been racing well up against some of the best two year olds in the state. He could be a major improver today. CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (6), BROBENAH GIRL (7) and BRUZER (4) are the main dangers.

JAKES SPORTWRITER (1) gets the inside draw today and has the speed to hold the lead. Once he leads over 1800 he becomes a hard horse to catch. CELESTIAL ZODIAC (7) hasn’t won a race for a while and gets a tricky draw but his recent Victorian form must be respected in a race like this. TAKE MY WALLET (8) and LINXX (2) are also chances.

NOT VICIOUS (8) will need some luck from the second row draw but she has had a nice start to her racing career. If she can get a quiet run and get out late she will be hard to beat. MY ULTIMATE BANJO (6) experiences a major class drop today. He could easily win this sort of race. ULTIMATE SAFARI (1) and VINNIES HOPE (2) are also chances.

CELESTIAL NEBULAE (8) will need some luck from the draw but he is another one who has Victorian form which is hard to ignore. If he can get out late he will be hard to hold out. IM BIG BUSINESS (4), SWEETKINDOFMAGIC (9) and MY ULTIMATE HENRY (3) are all major chances.

A MAJOR STARR (1) hasn’t been racing his best recently but he get’s the inside draw today which will make him a major threat of leading all of the way. RESURRECTS (7) won’t like the draw today but he is racing well. He has the ability to be too good for this field if he can bring his best performance and overcome the draw. NIGHT SPIRIT (4) and STAR OF WILLOUGHBY (9) are also chances.

CAPTAINS DREAM (1) is another runner who isn’t the most reliable but today he receives a draw where he can hold the lead. If he leads he will be hard to run down. DASHING COWBOY (7) looks like a big danger. The draw isn’t ideal but he knows how to win races like this. WHITESTARCHRISTIAN (9) and GIANT JACKSON (5) are also chances. OVERVIEW:KEAYANG MINNESOTA (5) commenced from the handicap of 30m, made a mid-race move to find the lead and scored comfortably at Terang seven days ago. This is a field of very similar standard and she is clearly the horse to beat. WHISKEY DAWN (6) broke at start and worked into a distant fourth in the Swan Hill Cup last outing. She hasn’t finished further back than fourth at her past six starts and should run her usual honest race. HAPPY ESCAPE (3) was able to outstay his rivals when resuming at Mount Gambier then followed with a second behind KEAYANG MINNESOTA (5), where he worked to the front then took cover. He has the best handicap out of the major chances and should be prominent throughout. WHY NOW (7) trailed the leader and gained a clear passage at the right time when he accelerated nicely to grab victory on the line at Ballarat last outing. He commences from a tough handicap but is not without a chance. BACK: KEAYANG MINNESOTA (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: KEAYANG MINNESOTA (5), WHISKEY DAWN (6), HAPPY ESCAPE (3), WHY NOW (7)

OVERVIEW:JUST LIKE NUGGET (4) is racing in good form having been placed at his past five attempts. He finished off reasonably well for third behind Krissy in a slick mile rate of 1.57.3 at Charlton last outing and should prove hard to beat under these conditions. VINNY ROCK (7) will appreciate a drop back in class on his latest performances and is versatile enough to overcome the wide draw. He settled midfield and held his own in a sizzling final half of 55.8 seconds when fourth at Ballarat last outing. SMOKIN STREPO (1) was heavily supported and justified the confidence with a big victory in a career best mile rate of 1.57.2 at Terang last week. He is drawn to find the lead again and should take catching. VILLAGE VOICE (6) will find this race to be a little easier than her recent performances so she is a possible improver. BACK: JUST LIKE NUGGET (4) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: JUST LIKE NUGGET (4), VINNY ROCK (7), SMOKIN STREPO (1), VILLAGE VOICE (6)

OVERVIEW: KEAYANG PASSION (7) will appreciate a huge drop back in class for this assignment. She finished third in the Super Series Final, followed with a second in the Gold Chalice then competed against the star filly Bettor Beach in the Victoria Oaks series. She endured a tough trip and had excuses in the Victoria Oaks Final so she will take beating under these conditions. COLOSIMO (6) is a versatile pacer, which produced a strong finish to score over LOUS MAMBO (2) at Terang last week. He hasn’t finished further back than fourth in twelve starts to date and he should run his usual honest race. STEEL MIKI (5) recorded a slick mile rate of 1.56.0 at Ballarat then finished off well in slick final sectionals at his latest third. He is a smart colt and looms as one of the leading chances. The stable mates LOUS MAMBO (2) and SWIM SUIT (3) both performed strongly at Terang last week and should go well again from their good draw. SELECTIONS: KEAYANG PASSION (7), COLOSIMO (6), STEEL MIKI (5), LOUS MAMBO (2)

OVERVIEW: PRETTY BASIC (5) is resuming since a Hamilton victory in April. He hasn’t been to the trials but he was competitive against better opposition when he was last in work and he will take beating if he is somewhere near his peak. PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (3) is a fast beginner and led throughout at an Ararat victory on August 23. He is a good chance of getting across to the markers shortly after the start and is worth an investment. EASTBRO MIKA (8) was a big winning chance but galloped when turning for home at her latest unplaced performance at Mount Gambier. She is better than her form reads and is a possible improver under these conditions. MARGARITARI (7) is racing consistently and is not without a chance despite the wide draw. He finished off nicely at his latest second behind Frankie Under Fire at Stawell. SELECTIONS: PRETTY BASIC (5), PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (3), EASTBRO MIKA (8), MARGARITARI (7)

OVERVIEW:MAJOR ROY (7) trailed the leader and tried hard in the straight when a narrow second behind Billys Tiger Khan at Ballarat. He is a strong pacer and is racing in good form so he is worth an investment. KEAYANG HUSTLER (6) impressed at his first two victories then endured a tough run and peaked over the final stages at his latest sixth. He is a smart colt and is worth another chance. WICKED HANGOVER (1) was resuming since June 2025 when she finished third after gaining a nice trail throughout at Swan Hill. She should have derived plenty of benefit from that performance and her form last preparation was strong so she must be respected. HUXHAM CHUBB (8) produced a terrific performance after parking without cover for the majority of the trip when a big winner at Terang last week. She is awkwardly drawn but is worth thought again. SELECTIONS: MAJOR ROY (7), KEAYANG HUSTLER (6), WICKED HANGOVER (1), HUXHAM CHUBB (8)

OVERVIEW:STEEL THE MOMENT (4) was resuming since July when he was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished sixth behind the open class pacer Ultimate Vinnie (won again since) then produced a big finish and just failed to gun down El Boston at Maryborough. He appears to be well placed against this field and is capable of returning to winning form. MADRIGAL (9) hasn’t had much luck since returning from New South Wales and is capable of improving on her numerical form. She dragged a flat tyre when fourth at Horsham then followed with an unplaced effort in the Ladyship Cup at Melton. She is a speedy mare and is likely to be finishing strongly. BROWNIESATMIDNIGHT (8) gets into this race with a concession claim and should be getting fitter after having two starts back from a spell so he must be respected. NANCYS BOY (5) ran a good race when resuming since July and is worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: STEEL THE MOMENT (4) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: STEEL THE MOMENT (4), MADRIGAL (9), BROWNIESATMIDNIGHT (8), NANCYS BOY (5)

OVERVIEW: DISPERSION (2) was headed off from the pole position and was shuffled back on the markers mid-race at Terang last week. He was last on the home turn and produced a big finish for an eye-catching fourth so he was very unlucky in that performance. He just failed to pick up Lambro Louella in a quick last quarter of 27.9 seconds when second at Horsham prior and he deserves to break through for a win. FLY HIGH MICKEY (1) is a debutante for trainer Matthew Craven, which produced a strong finishing burst to win a trial at Terang last week. He obviously has ability and must be respected. KEAYANG ALABAMA (7) progressed forward to race without cover and battled on well for fourth behind Swim Suit in a mile rate of 1.57.2 at Terang last week. This is a field of similar standard and he is worth an investment. WISHFUL DESIRE (5) has been runner up in two of her four starts to date and is capable of filling again from her reasonable draw. BACK: DISPERSION (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: DISPERSION (2), FLY HIGH MICKEY (1), KEAYANG ALABAMA (7), WISHFUL DESIRE (5)

OVERVIEW:SUZYS DREAM (2) is in flying form, having won two of her last three starts. The run she didn’t win can be forgotten, as she was checked early. When winning last start at Shepparton, she raced in the breeze and was simply too good. She has the best sectional times in this event, but she is surrounded by horses with good gate speed, so the map could be awkward for her. OUR TINKA BELLA (8) is a mare who has had only three career starts and is yet to get it right with her manners under race conditions. She raced in the breeze last start and looked the winner before galloping in the final few strides and being relegated to third. If she trots throughout, she has a motor. CHINSKI (3) has been a bit unlucky recently, being checked at his last two starts. His runs prior were good, however. He has gate speed and experience and should be able to map well here. VAN DOREN (4) doesn’t have great numerical form, but at his best, he has nice ability. He can be slow away and is often saved for one run late. If he can slot in somewhere close enough, he will be right in this. RIPPING RONALDO (10) has a motor and can win this if he trots, but he has galloped in five of his six starts. The one time he stayed trotting, he won. BACK: SUZYS DREAM (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SUZYS DREAM (2), OUR TINKA BELLA (8), CHINSKI (3), VAN DOREN (4)

OVERVIEW:RIDE HIGH CAPTIN (2) looks to be improving with each start. Last start, he battled on well for third after enjoying a nice run. He can go well here. HEAVENLY NIKKI (9) is always competitive and finishes close in these events. It surprises me that she is still a maiden, and she is a winning chance despite the barrier. DIMITRI (3) is a first starter for Chris Romanidis. He finished second in a recent trial at Geelong behind trotter Calabasas. We will learn more about him here. GOODMORNING MIKI (1) is an interesting runner. She is yet to have things go her way under race conditions, either making mistakes with her manners or being checked by other runners. Her trial form is good, though, and she has the barrier to map positively here. With a change in luck, she can win this. SELECTIONS: RIDE HIGH CAPTIN (2), HEAVENLY NIKKI (9), DIMITRI (3), GOODMORNING MIKI (1)

OVERVIEW:TOUCH OF REALITY (1) made an eye-catching run from last during the third quarter last start before finishing second. If he had been racing on the fence, his converted last quarters would have been 27.73 and 29.23. He has been racing well, has the ace barrier and possesses the gate speed to capitalise here. SEW HOPEFULL (3) looked close to breaking through for her maiden victory last start when battling out the finish with Keayang Maricruz. She has a good turn of foot. BETTER THAN DAICOS (4) over-raced last start and tired at Mildura, so that is a run we can put a line through. The start prior, he led and finished second behind the smart Notguilty. This looks like an easier contest. THATS ME AGAIN (5) rarely puts in a bad run but has recently come up against one or two slightly better horses. She let down nicely last start and is good enough if she is close enough. Also noting DIAMOND CHIPP (6), who has good sectional times heading into this event. BACK: TOUCH OF REALITY (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: TOUCH OF REALITY (1), SEW HOPEFULL (3), BETTER THAN DAICOS (4), THATS ME AGAIN (5)

OVERVIEW:OSCAROO (5) is a first starter for Fred Spiteri. He has good trial form and has appeared to be a safe trotter with a will to win. His trials have been run in slow times, so it is difficult to assess him against these trotters. However, we will learn more about him here. ROYAL LADY (1) is having her third career start for top trotting trainer Brent Lilley. She made a mistake with her manners on debut, but last start she battled on well in a field stronger than this one. Barrier one suits. DANCE WITH ROXY (2) has put it all together at her last two starts and has been eye-catching. She has good gate speed, a nice turn of foot and a good record at this track. HEMINGWAY SPECIAL (3) is a first starter for Denis Grieve. He is a full brother to My Ultimate Sunny, who looked to be a star before his career was seemingly cut short. His trials have been at Bacchus Marsh without replays, so it is difficult to gauge his ability. However, he is well bred and trained by Grieve, who is great with trotters. SELECTIONS: OSCAROO (5), ROYAL LADY (1), DANCE WITH ROXY (2), HEMINGWAY SPECIAL (3)

OVERVIEW:LORIMERMAJOR (1) finds a suitable race and barrier here to get back to his best form. He flashed home nicely from near last last start to finish second behind WHERES WOOD WOOD (8), who is drawn on his back here. WHERES WOOD WOOD (8) will be hoping LORIMERMAJOR (1) can hold the front and provide the perfect trail into the race. He is performing well and is well placed here. MONSIEUR FLAMEL (5) has a nice turn of foot, whether he is saved for one run or uses his gate speed early. The barrier makes things tricky, but he is a winning chance with some luck. SPEEDY HEALEY (4) is a consistent horse who is racing well and has the best sectional times in this field. The barrier is awkward, however. BACK: LORIMERMAJOR (1)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: LORIMERMAJOR (1), WHERES WOOD WOOD (8), MONSIEUR FLAMEL (5), SPEEDY HEALEY (4)

OVERVIEW:ANAKIN (6) is third-up here, so I expect him to be back to peak race fitness. He got fired up in the breeze last start at Kilmore but still battled on well for fourth. The barrier is awkward, but he is a smart type. FOREGONE CONCLUSION (7) got too far back last start but let down reasonably well in a race stronger than this one. He is a versatile, experienced horse who can make his own luck at this grade. BEAU BECA (3) produced an improved run last start, finishing a nice third after flashing home from three-back on the fence. If he gets a good run here, he is right in this. FOUR EVER A STAR (2) returned to the winners’ circle last start after building her fitness following a long time on the sidelines. She now has that winning confidence back. Also respecting JUSTLIKEDAVE (4) if he can find a good position in the race. BACK: ANAKIN (6)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ANAKIN (6), FOREGONE CONCLUSION (7), BEAU BECA (3), FOUR EVER A STAR (2)

OVERVIEW:TOMMYS LOOKOUT (2) has not been racing at his best, which is reflected in his numerical form. However, he has also had some bad luck and drawn poor barriers. He does have the gate speed, and if he can find the fence here, he is a threat. RIDDLEMETHIS (7) is in flying form this preparation. First-up, he stormed home from last to finish second. Last start, he did all the work and was simply too good. The barrier is a concern, as he will need to make his own luck, but he is racing well enough to win. ARE WEASLEY (5) rarely puts in a bad run, but he is first-up here, which could leave him vulnerable. OPERTSER (4) and MIKI MARK (6) are both racing well but will need to overcome tricky barriers. SELECTIONS: TOMMYS LOOKOUT (2), RIDDLEMETHIS (7), ARE WEASLEY (5), OPERTSER (4)

OVERVIEW:KRAKEY (7) let down nicely last start but was simply too far back. He is racing well, and this looks like a suitable race for him despite the tricky barrier. He has the best sectional times in this event. TEX GOES BANG (6) and HOME AND DRY (5) have similar form lines heading into this event. Both are horses who consistently run well when they get some luck. GLENLINE (8) is a great swooper. When saved for one run, he is always rattling home late. He is the only horse on the back row, so he will have options to stay or leave the fence. BACK: KRAKEY (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: KRAKEY (7), TEX GOES BANG (6), HOME AND DRY (5), GLENLINE (8)

OVERVIEW:BETTORLEFTALONE (4) and REFUSAL (3) are two exciting new additions to the Alex Ashwood stable from New South Wales. BETTORLEFTALONE (4) comes out of the Victoria Derby. He tired in the Final after a tough run in a brilliant field, but he finished a good fourth in his heat, defeating some talented horses. He looks well placed here. REFUSAL (3) is a classy mare who rarely puts in a bad run. However, she may be vulnerable first-up since June. WITH IN REASON (7) has a brilliant turn of foot, which he showed in early August when he looped the field to win impressively at Melton. If there is speed on early here, he will be ready to strike late. EMILY VINCENT (2) may find this difficult, but she should be able to map well and has a nice turn of foot. She also has great gate speed if connections choose to use it. SELECTIONS: BETTORLEFTALONE (4), REFUSAL (3), WITH IN REASON (7), EMILY VINCENT (2) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (2) has been in great form of late and draws an ideal gate in this even field. EVERYTHING BUT THE (1) is first up in a month and will be looking to make full use of the pole draw. You would expect LYNRYD SKYNRYD (6) to again push forward hard from his wide gate in an attempt to find a position on speed. He has been thereabouts of late but will need to improve to be winning here. WAZZA (3) should get a nice run just off the speed and be running home strongly, while WE SALUTE YOU (8) should get his preferred pegs run and could be the one at odds if the gaps appear late. Selections:DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (2), EVERYTHING BUT THE (1), WAZZA (3), WE SALUTE YOU (8)

An even field comes together for the No More Than One Win horses, where ROBUST SALLY (1) again draws the pole after breaking through for her maiden victory last start. This is obviously a tougher field, but she looks to get her chance again for an all-the-way victory. TISU SUNNY (3) gets the best draw he has had in a while and may look to take advantage of that, with plenty of ability on his day. LITTLE CAPPUCCINA (6) is another who broke her maiden last start and may look to zoom to the pegs to give herself her best chance. COMINSKI LEIS (8) is a back-row runner who has produced some nice races in his short career and would benefit from any tempo throughout, as will BRIGHTLY BLAZE (7) from the outside front-row draw. SNIPER SANZ (4) could be the one at odds if he races more genuinely this week, while SWEETHEART DIOR (2) also gets a nice draw to find a spot on speed and gets her chance after some consistent performances. Selections:COMINSKI LEIS (8), TISU SUNNY (3), SWEETHEART DIOR (2), ROBUST SALLY (1)

A two-year-old event for the maidens, where you would expect VINCENT THE THIRD (1) to look to take advantage of his good draw. He ran some nice races with slick last halves earlier in the year before having little luck of late, so expect him to be right in the finish here. ANN PENNY (3) was a well-backed favourite first up in the state and looked disappointing on face value, but was found to have had a flat tyre for the entire race, so her effort to finish as close as she did was commendable. BABY CHARLOTTE (4) is first up from a break after being handy on debut and should have taken plenty of improvement from that run. BETTOR CALL LOU (7) was seen flashing home late in a slowly run race first up from a break and will benefit from any genuine tempo throughout to be running into the finish. Selections:VINCENT THE THIRD (1), ANN PENNY (3), BETTOR CALL LOU (7), BABY CHARLOTTE (4)

OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (1) will look for another all-the-way victory here after holding them off late following a fast burn early last start. She looks well placed with the dual claim to put another victory on the board. PHLOW JO (3) also uses a dual claim to get into this race and has been putting together some consistent performances of late. FAMILY REASONS (2) should get a nice sit with cover and looks the main danger, with plenty of ability on his day. LETSGOBRO (5) is going better than his form suggests and looks the only other likely winning chance if they are able to find a five-point claiming driver. Selections:OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (1), FAMILY REASONS (2), PHLOW JO (3), LETSGOBRO (5)

OUR SWEET TRIXIE (2) will be looking to use her good gate speed to be first to the pegs and attempt an all-the-way victory. She has been racing consistently of late and normally grows a leg in front, although she is better suited over the mile distance. Her chances could be reliant on whether she receives any pressure throughout, which is most likely to come from BUSLOAD OF FAITH (8), the lone back-row runner. MY BAD (3) produced an improved effort when second last start and should find a nice spot on speed with cover to be in the finish. OUR DANCE MONKEY (6) also ran well last start, only getting rolled in the final 50 metres after copping pressure throughout in handy time. If she settles better in the running, she could take some holding out late. SOLO SAFARI (7) is going better than his form suggests and will be reliant on a genuine tempo to be running home strongly, while DAISYPEA (5) only needs to bring some of her good two-year-old form to be a big danger, but may need to improve on her recent trial performances in what is a very even field. Selections:OUR SWEET TRIXIE (2), MY BAD (3), OUR DANCE MONKEY (6), DAISYPEA (5)

A strong field of mares comes together for the feature race, drawn on lifetime earnings, where the progressive CRAYONS TO PERFUME (1) will be looking to take advantage of the pole draw once again. There looks to be some good gate speed drawn to her outside, so the pressure could be on early. ULTIMACTION (6) returns from a good break after being in outstanding form last preparation, putting a string of victories together. She has trialled nicely for her return and expect her to be driven confidently from the wide gate. OUR NAKED ART (3) arrives in the state bringing some strong metropolitan form and, if able to find a spot on speed with cover, could take some holding out late. OUR WILLOW (4) has been consistent of late and is another who will be looking to slot in early to give herself her best chance. CARMEN EMJAY (9) returns after a strong second in the $100,000 Beautide and should be able to find a midfield position following out a handy beginner. SWIATEK LEIS (10) and STEPPING STONES (11) are the best performed mares of the field, hence drawing the worst, and will be relying on some genuine tempo up front to allow them to run home strongly late. Selections:ULTIMACTION (6),OUR NAKED ART (3), CARMEN EMJAY (9), CRAYONS TO PERFUME (1)

The Danbury Park Cup feature brings together a full field from the stand start over the long distance, where HORATIUS SPECULO (11) will be looking to add another victory to his name. He meets a stronger field today than he has at his past two starts, but you can't discount his class and he will be looking to use his speed late to be running home strongly. MAEBEE (10), GO THE RED (12) and BETTABLACK TIGER (13) are the other 20-metre runners and have all been racing consistently, so expect them to be running home strongly. THE SHALLOWS (9) is first up from a break but gets a 10-metre advantage and looks quite well handicapped at his best. ROCKANDAHARDPLACE (7) will look to ping to the front and run them along at his even tempo, where he does his best racing. I suspect the rest of the front-running horses will be battling it out for the placings at best, as they lack the class of some of the runners coming off the handicaps. Selections:HORATIUS SPECULO (11), THE SHALLOWS (9), GO THE RED (12), BETTABLACK TIGER (13)

WEE GEORGIE WOOD (1) again draws the pole, being a low lifetime-win horse, and should be best suited dropping back to the mile distance, where he does his best racing and has run some slick times recently. LAID BACK (2) gets the draw to find a nice spot on speed and will no doubt loom as a winning chance late. HAY MIKI (3) also draws the best he has in a while and will be looking to take up a forward position and find some cover, most likely off MY WAY (4), who you would expect to push forward again from the middle of the front row. MOVESLIKEALADY (11) draws her usual ODM position and will again be relying on some strong tempo throughout and a clever drive to get her home, but she can never be left out in these sorts of races. Selections:WEE GEORGIE WOOD (1), LAID BACK (2), HAY MIKI (3), MOVESLIKEALADY (11)

FARROH JOE (1) is a two-year-old taking on the older horses but looks extremely hard to beat over the short distance. He was good when sitting outside them and doing the work last week in the Dandy Patch heats and should be winning his tasbred bonus in the process here. SUMTHIN ELSE (2) has been okay in both starts this preparation and looks like getting another nice run on speed with cover, giving her every chance to run into the placings. KYRGIOS (3) and FEELINKINDALUCKY (4) may push forward from their middle front-row draws and hope to gain some cover from PUNTARNO STRIDE (7), who you would expect to be driven aggressively from the wide front-row draw, as he has been at previous starts. DEBT TILL WE PART (8) follows the expected favourite through from the back row and should get his chance to be in the finish if the gaps appear late. Selections:FARROH JOE (1), DEBT TILL WE PART (8), SUMTHIN ELSE (2), PUNTARNO STRIDE (7) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:GAELIC LADY (7) turned in an impressive debut displaying good manners, gate speed and won with plenty in hand by a big margin. Granted, the time wasn’t overly quick, opposition wasn’t strong and they did things wrong, but she looked to have decent ability for this level. She can afford to be assertively driven again over the short trip, and a repeat of last time is good enough to beat these. MINNIE MIA (4) has good gate speed and is likely to cross to the pegs first here to get the right trip. Even though her form doesn’t look flash, she’s down slightly in class and competitive at this level. SHINELIKETHESUN (8) has displayed ability throughout her 16 starts but has been her own worst enemy on occasions with her manners letting her down. If she does everything right expect her to be in the finish. THE TROUT COD (2) was able to get her maiden last time over the long trip where she was able to be driven cold and won easily in slow time. That effort seemed to contrast with what she had done previously but is worth consideration with a similar trajectory. WIND STORM (5) is first up of a trial win, and any market moves should be respected also. BACK: GAELIC LADY (7)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:GAELIC LADY (7), MINNIE MIA (4), SHINELIKETHESUN (8), THE TROUT COD (2)

OVERVIEW:GLORIFIED (7) resumes here off a solid 2yo campaign which yielded a win and competed in the Nutrien series before going out for a solid break. He’s had plenty of time at the trials in preparation for this, and most recently won here in decent time. If he’s forward enough and brings his manners, he has the quality to beat these. BIG RAIN (6) is fast beginner evidenced by her all the way win three back where she was able to dictate and win in slow time. If she gets the right map, she’s in the mix. CARTALCHA (4) has had her chances recently, but this race presents as a favourable opportunity to improve on her from the positive gate. FIRST IN FLIGHT (9) won on debut coming from near last in a slow last half, but she displayed nice balance in her action, and should be finding the line well again, but her chances are tempo related. FRANCOAMERICANO (5) hasn’t been trotting that well his past two back from a break, but he did display ability last preparation, so with more fitness now could be open to improvement. SABIHALIL (1) and MAORIS AVENGER (3) tend to do everything right and may map well to have claims at the minor end. SELECTIONS:GLORIFIED (7), BIG RAIN (6), CARTALCHA (4), FIRST IN FLIGHT (9)

OVERVIEW:WEDGE TAIL EAGLE (5) is getting close to breaking his maiden on the back of three solid runs this campaign the most recent where he narrowly missed to a horse who’ s been racing in solid form. He doesn’t seem against working in his races, so the sticky map may not be a disadvantage to get a forward spot of what will likely be a slow tempo. OVER HERE (9) has a solid SP profile and could potentially map well here despite the trailing draw. He was below par when favourite last time, but his runs prior suggest there’s talent if he gets the right trip. SYNTAX ERROR (3) was driven cold and came with a nice finish in a slow last half last time out. She’s been thrown in the deep end a few times and this lineup look more suitable. LEZAMA (1) has good early gate speed and looks the most likely leader and if she gets a soft enough run up front can be in the finish. SELECTIONS:WEDGE TAIL EAGLE (5), OVER HERE (9), SYNTAX ERROR (3), LEZAMA (1)

OVERVIEW:FRANKS ALOT (5) was quite good on debut forced to sit parked outside the winner who’s racing well, and they ran decent time for this class. He should be improved by that outing and may map reasonably well with speed inside and out. This stable seems to strike well with their young trotters and looks the testing material. ELARIA (2) creates plenty of interest as a first-starting 3yo filly who was prepped up in Sydney before switching to the Cotchin barn. She had one trial locally where she seemed ok, without it being a dazzling outing. Herbertson going on is a massive advantage to give her every chance. WALKING ON WATER (4) is a 15-start maiden but she’s getting closer to a win after 3 solid 2nds in her past 4 starts. She has gate speed to put herself at the top end and Bellman seems to get on well with her. UNCLE BILL (1) has good early gate speed which has helped him in nabbing a couple of placings in his 3 starts. He was quite plain last time when he had every hope, but these conditions suit. DANCE WITH ROXY (6) is going quite well her past couple and does have gate speed, but whether she can cross to the pegs is problematic. COLLEAGUES (11) seems to have ability but isn’t trotting reliably but is worth keeping safe in case he puts it together. SELECTIONS:FRANKS ALOT (5), ELARIA (2), WALKING ON WATER (4), DANCE WITH ROXY (6)

OVERVIEW:BETSY ANNE (7) has been costly lately, going down as favourite in 3 of her last four starts, but she just keeps striking races like this where it feels challenging to be confident of tipping anything to beat her. She’s drawn wide, but her pattern is to race forward, and Herbertson is always a massive plus in these types of races. CASTLES IN THE SKY (9) can be hard to catch and was beaten a long way when in the market last time but was solid the run prior. She’s normally best off the front row, but this race isn’t strong. LAVENGERS BOY (4) was a winner here back in June but hasn’t been able to deliver a similar performance since. This is easiest race he’s been in for a while so is open to improvement. TENSION SEEKER (2) is a quick beginner and will look for the top over this trip. She does come back in class, but she's come up empty-handed for a win in 44 starts at this track. It’s an impossible race to be confident with so throw in AZALEA MAE (1), MISS AVENGER (4) and ALLAWART BOB (8) if you want a bit of extra insurance for wider exotics. SELECTIONS:BETSY ANNE (7), CASTLES IN THE SKY (9), LAVENGERS BOY (4), TENSION SEEKER (2)

OVERVIEW:FLING IT RAINBOW (5) is a speedy beginner who will look for the top here at a track he has a liking and a distance he enjoys. He’s been racing consistently lately and was a winner over similar distance five back after getting a good run in transit. He will be map dependant but is a likeable option in an open race. KYVALLEY MISTY (8) has a strong trainer/driver combo but is awkwardly drawn off the back row. She has more ability than most in this, and although she needs luck, with clear running will be strong late. CHARLIE WALKER (2) is another speedy beginner who will likely get to the pegs first and has options thereafter. He’s enjoying a decent season at this level and does boast a solid record at this track and distance. MONEY TALKS (6) often has the flashing light on him, hence a solid SP profile, but his lack of gate speed means he’s often giving them a start. SONNYBOY (3) and MI BOW (10) have claims at the minor end. SELECTIONS:FLING IT RAINBOW (5), KYVALLEY MISTY (8), CHARLIE WALKER (2), MONEY TALKS (6)

OVERVIEW:REVERAND BOB (5) drops back sharply in grade here after racing well against the best in his age group in the Vicbred and Need For Speed series. He was a good winner two back at Melton and the form out of that race has stood up ok. He can press forward from this draw, and whilst there’s a bit of speed to his inside, he still should map ok. Herbertson and Chircop enjoy a great strike rate together and this race looks most suitable to win again. TRUSCOTTS ELEGANCE (4) is another who comes out of strong age group company, where she ran a good race to finish 4th in the Trotters Oaks. Before that she wasn’t running well in strong races from tricky draws. Her last win was at this track at decent odds, but the horses she defeated have raced well since. She appears the main danger. I CHOOSE YOU (7) has a tricky draw to overcome but did win four back in nice fashion and then took on some smarter ones in the Vicbred series. He was a forgive last time after breaking early when inconvenienced by another runner. JILLIBY RADIANCE (10) comes through a G1 also and she did things wrong there. She was a winner the start prior when leading and beating Truscotts Elegance but now has a tricky draw to overcome. OMNIA (2) is an interesting type who had nice Adelaide form and at her first start for the new camp somehow led from the backrow but knocked up over the last 200m. She may benefit from that outing and is worth keeping safe. BACK: REVERAND BOB (5)– 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:REVERAND BOB (5), TRUSCOTTS ELEGANCE (4), I CHOOSE YOU (7), JILLIBY RADIANCE (10)

OVERVIEW: Standing start for the trotters over the middle trip. ROMANTIC NINA (4) is perhaps better under mobile conditions, but if she begins safely her form stacks up well in this lineup. She was a winner at Melton in a slightly easier race two back, and last time she did it tough outside the speed and just as she was ready to strike, broke in running. If she happened to find the top end she would take plenty of catching. OFF YOUR FACESKI (10) won the Swan Hill Trotters Cup last start from the same handicap, albeit over the longer trip. He gave them a whipping there winning by a space at big odds, and does have a good record under the stand, even though he’s not foolproof away. AVANT GUARD (8) is yet to win under the standing start conditions but does meet some of these from a better handicap, so he could be open to sharp improvement. PARIS KAY (6) is adept in most conditions, and although she runs her best races up on the speed, with a safe beginning can get in front of some key rivals. JAYS ALL THAT (5) is going ok but would need to race near the front to be a hope and CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (9) was a winner last time but that was from the front row. SELECTIONS:ROMANTIC NINA (4), OFF YOUR FACESKI (10), AVANT GUARD (8), PARIS KAY (6)

OVERVIEW:QUAKE PROOF (1) is first up from a break here and finds himself in the rare situation where he’s drawn to map well and use his strong finish. He’s been racing up in grade and going well from tough set-ups and despite giving away a fitness edge, the short trip and chance to come with one run appeals at likely value. KISS AT MIDNIGHT (6) is a very fast beginner and is also first up here, suited by the likely map and short distance. He was a good trial winner recently at Melton, and with Alford aboard she will get every chance. KAMARAN (2) has ability and returns to the front row after not having much luck his past few. The draw helps his chances, although he’s come up empty handed at nine attempts at this track. MAJESTIC CHARMA (4) has been going well in slightly easier company than this and has shown versatility in those runs. There’s a few better but she’s in the mix. NO TELLING HEATHER (9) has been going well in easier company and from better set ups, but she’s honest enough to include in calculations. BACK: QUAKE PROOF (1)– 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:QUAKE PROOF (1), KISS AT MIDNIGHT (6), KAMARAN (2), NO TELLING HEATHER (9)

OVERVIEW:AT THE DISTANCE (2) looks well served by the inside draw to be driven hard to hold the lead over the short trip. He’s been racing well in somewhat more challenging set ups, and the last time he was able to find the front five runs back at Melton he was a comfortable winner, and this race looks ideal to go all the way. NEDZA THRILLER (10) has accounted for some of these recently from front row draws, and the back row makes his task more challenging this time, but he must be respected. ATTRACTED (8) if the map works out as expected can catch leaders back here and was close in a decent race from that position last time. SNICKERS EXPRESS (9) is often popular with punters at this level and has placed 10 from 22 this season but is still chasing that elusive victory. ALDEBARAN MARCUS (4), BUCKLES FOR BERRY (5) and CONNIES PRESIDENT (11) all have claims at the minor end of the prize. BACK: AT THE DISTANCE (2)– 3.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:AT THE DISTANCE (2), NEDZA THRILLER (10), ATTRACTED (8), SNICKERS EXPRESS (9)

OVERVIEW:KEAYANG VIPER (9) has progressed to this level quickly as a lightly raced 4yo and has looked stylish in her eight career starts, which have yielded six wins, including a good-quality victory at Menangle in NSW last week. This stable has a very good strike rate with these progressive types, particularly those they've been patient with. While most of her wins have come from racing at the top end of the map, she has the speed and ability to overcome a less favourable position. GUNFORHIRE (7) is such a consistent type who, to be fair, hasn't had much luck with barrier draws, which has often hurt his winning strike rate. He will need luck again, but you know he'll be giving his all. SAVON DE ROCHE (8) has form around the top pick and has been terrific in those races, while also franked by her form either side of them. She's a little awkwardly drawn, but she's going too well not to consider. SPOOK CROCKER (4) is an interesting runner, with good Mount Gambier form, which rarely stacks up at this level, but he's worth keeping safe. PISTOL PEARCE (3) has the speed to lead and may find this a little more suitable, while PLATINUM JIVE (5) has her fair share of talent and has claims if she gets the luck she needs. BACK: KEAYANG VIPER (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:KEAYANG VIPER (9), GUNFORHIRE (7), SAVON DE ROCHE (8), PLATINUM JIVE (5)

OVERVIEW:JILLIBY SNIPER (4) looks a nice 3yo who, like his stablemate in Race 1, has reached this level very quickly, with five wins from nine starts. He had a crack at qualifying for the Derby, and even though he dropped back to a more suitable grade last time, the quality of the opposition was strong. He has the barrier draw advantage over his main rival, Thunderfire, which may be the decisive factor. THUNDERFIRE (10) has been terrific in his lightly raced career of only 11 starts, and you can mount a case that he's been most unlucky not to register more than four wins. He was terrific through the Vicbred Series and lost no admirers last week when sitting parked in good time and sticking on gamely. He's a versatile type who can work or come with one run, so has that in his favour to overcome the back-row draw. BANDIT EYES (7) failed last start at Wagga but was terrific in winning here the start prior when able to lead all the way in good time. If he recaptures that form, he's well in the mix to win again, while stablemate REFUSAL (8) also creates plenty of interest having her first start for the camp. While she needs to improve significantly, this stable has a good record with new acquisitions. While there's confidence around the top two picks, the minor end is wide open, with RONNIE THE HAMMER (6), TELEMACHUS (9) and KING SAINT (11) all in with a show. BACK: JILLIBY SNIPER (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:JILLIBY SNIPER (4), THUNDERFIRE (11), BANDIT EYES (7), TELEMACHUS (9)

OVERVIEW:QUIRKY CHARACTER (5) may fly under the radar here considering his numerical form, but he's been going okay from bad draws, running good times from unwinnable positions. He'll have a few in front of him again here, but there could be a bit of early speed to help him, and the smaller field to round them up is also in his favour. He should be a nice value play. KEAYANG LAVITA (4) has been mixing it between standing starts and mobile conditions and racing well. Her failures have often been the result of having to do too much work in quick time. She has speed, but so do a couple inside and outside her, so the map could be a little tricky. However, if she gets the right trip, she's hard to beat. KARBINE (3) has really delivered on his potential this preparation, winning six of 23 starts, with a couple of those victories coming in town at a good level. He can float into a nice enough position from the draw, and his tough run last start is worth forgiving as he looks to bounce back. IRON WOMEN (1) can be expected to utilise her speed from the pole draw, and over this trip that's a big advantage. She is up in grade, however, so she may feel the pressure late. The chances don't end there, with MAORIS MAC (6) possessing good ability, and even NAKEDTRUTH (2), EL RESAMO (7) and MEADOW VALLEY STAR (9) wouldn't shock the way they're going, as they can perform at this level with the right run. It's an open race. SELECTIONS:QUIRKY CHARACTER (5), KEAYANG LAVITA (4), KARBINE (3), IRON WOMEN (1)

OVERVIEW:TIMMY TURTLE (4) looks very well placed against this line-up, considering his form last season against some quality types. He now has the benefit of one run back from a long break, where he ran well without being knocked around. He goes to the front row now to utilise his gate speed over the short trip, and if he's come on from last start, he looks very hard to beat and one of the best of the night. KEAYANG GYPSY (7) is ever consistent and racing well this preparation. Despite the draw, connections may elect to roll forward under these favourable conditions to race close to the speed. She was racing smarter types last time, albeit in a small field. DELS DESTINY (5) is often dependent on tempo, as he's a sit-and-sprint type, but he's been in nice form of late, including a win here two starts back. Look for him late. KYVALLEY MICHAEL (8) was racing well, but he's been off his game in his past few runs. He's back in a suitable grade, so improvement wouldn't surprise. HAY JET (3) is a most interesting runner who hasn't been seen since 2024, when he notched three wins from three starts in easier grade. He's had one trial leading into this, where they didn't go overly quickly, but he did hit the line well, although he looked to be knocking up late. He will need the run but watch him with interest. BACK: TIMMY TURTLE (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:TIMMY TURTLE (4), KEAYANG GYPSY (7), DELS DESTINY (5), KYVALLEY MICHAEL (8)

OVERVIEW:COLTRANE (6) made a nice return last start at Geelong, where he drifted back and copped a check from an unruly runner. He took a bit of time to get balanced thereafter, but when he did, he hit the line very well. There doesn't look to be much pressure in the race, which is a slight concern for a horse who likes to come with one run, but he looks to have more upside than most of the opposition here. AGAINST THE BRIDLE (7) is in a purple patch of form, and that's largely due to his manners and ability to put himself up on the pace and grind them down. That pattern may make him a sitting shot for the favourite, but he'll be in it for a long way. CALABASAS (3) is worth forgiving for her last run, where she started off the back row and was wiped out at the start. Prior to that, she was a winner at this track, albeit in an easier race, but deserves consideration. NIGHT FLIGHT (2) is a very quick beginner and looks a comfortable leader here. He's been consistent this season and is a threat over the short trip, but he's come up empty-handed in six starts at this track. BACK: COLTRANE (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:COLTRANE (6), AGAINST THE BRIDLE (7), CALABASAS (3), NIGHT FLIGHT (2)

OVERVIEW:ROCKY VALLEY (2) could be open to sharp improvement here, getting a good draw to show his versatility against opposition that seems more favourable than what he's been facing. He did lead and fade over the longer trip three back, but maybe he spent too many tickets early, whereas this draw seems a lot more favourable to have a look for the top or find good cover. He can give a sight at decent value. ALDEBARAN SUSANNE (6) returns to the front row and can show her good gate speed from the same draw she was able to find the pegs from three back, where she finished a good 2nd. This trip and class suit her, and she will be hard to beat. CARLA PIXIE (8) returns to mobile conditions, which is preferable after a few standing starts in SA. Prior to that, she ran some nice races at this track from the same draw with a low SP profile, so she's in the mix again despite needing some luck. ALDEBARAN SUE (7) hasn't been trotting well since her stint in Queensland, but it's hard to leave her out against this opposition considering her ability. If she can show any glimpse of what she's capable of, improvement wouldn't surprise. SELECTIONS:ROCKY VALLEY (2), ALDEBARAN SUSANNE (6), CARLA PIXIE (8), ALDEBARAN SUE (7)

OVERVIEW:KENNYS SON (5) is a quick beginner under mobile conditions and gets the opportunity to race forward here and be given every hope over the short trip. He was able to lead and win in good time at Shepparton two runs back with Herbertson aboard and has a decent record at this track to suggest that if he gets the right trip, he's the one to catch. LOCKSLEY CAVALIER (6) was well supported here when first up, but he ran well below par and was sent back to the trials. He stepped out well in that trial to suggest the performance may have been an anomaly. He has shown decent ability at a stronger level than he meets here, so expect him to bounce back quickly. DOSSIER (2) is starting to get back to some decent form with a couple of placings recently. She has won at this track in this type of grade, and the soft draw helps her chances of going close. MISS KOMMUNICATION (3), MAJESTIC MONARCH (4) and KYVALLEY JAGGER (8) would all surprise with victory but have claims at the minor end. BACK: KENNYS SON (5) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS:KENNYS SON (5), LOCKSLEY CAVALIER (6), DOSSIER (2), MAJESTIC MONARCH (4)

OVERVIEW:ISOLATION (7) drops back significantly in grade after a good 3rd here last week, where he didn't have the best luck in transit early and still found the line well. He's reunited with Herbertson here, who tends to get the best out of him, evidenced by driving four of his five wins this season. The extra distance helps him take up a forward position and control the tempo from the top end, making him hard to run down. SEATHESTARS (4) is a high-quality 4yo who comes here third up after two runs in the Vicbred Series, the first where he was very good when 3rd and able to map behind the leader, then was beaten a long way in the final without an obvious excuse. He's now had a month between runs, and if you purely assess him on the terrific runs he put in last season in the top 3yo races, he's clearly got the class, but it's hard to know where he's at. TOORAM MAGIC (6) resumed with a nice 2nd behind an in-form horse last time out and strung together some solid performances last campaign. The map might be a little tricky, but if he gets a good trail into it, he can finish off late. MY LITTLE BO (2) is a quick beginner and will look to map behind the leader or, most likely, three pegs. She's much better over the short trip, but her run here last week was solid enough to consider. SELECTIONS:ISOLATION (7), SEATHESTARS (4), TOORAM MAGIC (6), MY LITTLE BO (2)

OVERVIEW:RUBYS DREAM (5) is a very quick beginner, evidenced by her two recent wins here from gates five and seven, where she was able to lead over the short trip and run very good time for this grade. This race doesn't present as any harder than last time, so if she can cross and lead, a repeat of that performance can be enough to get the job done. IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (6) is a high-quality opponent who's turned in some terrific runs this season, including three wins. He's most likely forced into a map-negative position here, which will make it hard to bridge the margin to the leaders, but he'll be giving his all. FREIGHT SHAKER (2) is another consistent type drawn favourably to get a nice map from the inside draw. He ran a PB time last time out, and if he can improve on that, he can go close. The rest all have claims at the minor end, with a slight leaning towards KEAYANG KURKI (7) as the best of those. SELECTIONS:RUBYS DREAM (5), IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (6), FREIGHT SHAKER (2), KEAYANG KURKI (7)

BESTINBEDS.COM.AU PACE ON DASHER (1) has shown big talent in overcoming tricky draws to win his two starts to date. Worked forward from the extreme outside before finding the front and saluting by 7.6m here last week. This is a big class jump but he gets the ace draw. GOODTIME LOUIS (5) made a solid start in NSW when he finished third at this circuit and distance last week, beaten 4 metres. Likely to have come on from that so is capable of getting the job done. MICK DANGER (6) draws wide but did well in scoring by 1.6 metres in a higher-graded race at this circuit and distance last week. Could go on with it now that he is back in winning form. A good draw gives NOVANTA RISING (3) the chance to show his best while BARTELLO (10) may require luck from a wide barrier but is suited back in class having won here the last time he raced in this grade.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 3YO FILLIES - SEMI FINAL 1 STRIPES (4) stretched her winning streak to four when she came from a couple of spots deeper to score by 7m at this circuit and distance last time. Was also drawn deeper when she won the Triad Final in Brisbane prior. The latest win was her first outing for more than five weeks so she should be better for it. Can deliver again. EYE WISH (5) comes here off back-to-back Wagga wins, the latest by 2.3m in a heat of this series when off the back row. She is in peak form at the right time. GO EASY ON ME (3) scored from the outside barrier when resuming here and has been runner-up from the back row in both outings since. Kept up to the mark with a trial win and is unbeaten at this circuit and distance. Player from a good draw. FAKE FRIENDS (9) found form when leading to win a heat of this series here last week. Draws out but has yet to miss a place when third-up. OSHLEY (6) was a class above last start after a close second here fresh. Draws a bit wide but should be peaking.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 3YO COLTS AND GELDINGS - SEMI-FINAL 1 YOTTIE (5) has been dominant in winning his two outings since a spell, drawing very wide but working to the front in a heat of this series here last week and cruising home by close to 11m. The previous time he raced at this circuit he placed in the NSW Derby. He is two from three when third-up and looks the one to beat. ALERT BAY (8) chased boom colt Loucasso for three straight seconds before landing a well-deserved win at this circuit and distance last start, working to the front from a similar draw to this before scoring by 7m. He could do that again. ENJABONARLO (2) has been racing well from wider barriers, recording a win in a heat of this series at Bathurst along with two placings at this circuit and distance from his last three outings. Draws to play a role again as does ETHANS REVENGE (1) who has some decent form behind him including a win here three back and he should enjoy a soft run.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 4YO ENTIRES AND GELDINGS - SEMI-FINAL 1 SEASIDER (3) was last seen when fourth to Captain Mistress in the Rising Sun four months ago, a solid end to a successful campaign highlighted by wins in the Riverina Championship and the state final of the Regional Championships, the latter at this venue. Yet to miss a place when fresh and was readied with a trial win. The good draw gives him the chance for a winning return. JUNGLE DRAGON (5) has been close to the placings in Listed FFA races in his last two outings, coming from very wide to be beaten less than 5m last week. Draws lower and is well placed. Big threat. The ace draw brings DANCE WITH CARMER (1) right into contention having won at Newcastle the last time he started on the pegs three back. FOREVER ONTHE PUNT (2) tackles a stronger bunch tonight but draws well and must be respected after winning his two outings here since joining Brad Hewitt.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 3YO FILLIES - SEMI FINAL 2 Brilliant filly ARK SEA (6) returns to the city following two dominant wins off a spell, leading to cruise home by 18m in a heat of this series when fresh at Bathurst then coming from the back row to beat older rivals at Wagga last time. Has the speed to go forward again from this draw so can add to a good record at this circuit and distance. ONE MORE REASON (8) is going well and made it two wins from her last three outings at this venue and distance when she worked to the front from a similar draw and got home by more than 5m last week. Expect her to push forward and be prominent again. YIRRADIVA (4) will relish a better draw having come from wide or second line barriers for a win and placings behind the top two sections in her last three starts. SEASIDE BOULEVARD (9) beat Ark Sea when runner-up in the Queensland Oaks last campaign. Draws wide but should be nearing her peak third up.

CLUB MENANGLE KEVIN ROBINSON FFA (LISTED CLASSIC) Grand pacer SWAYZEE (4) was brave in his resuming effort, coming from the back row and working to the front before sticking on for a 1.3m fourth in the Geelong Cup. Prefer him over further than the mile but his second-up record is strong so he should be improved. Aided by a good draw and if anywhere near his best he'll be too good for these. ITS CONFIDENTIAL (9) made a winning start for Brad Hewitt at his latest appearance, beating some handy rivals when scoring by 2 metres at Bathurst. Draws wide but he strikes at 50 per cent here. HEZA PUNK ROCKER (8) was good in his first outing for Seaton Grima last week, coming from a similar draw to place at Listed level at this circuit and distance. Expect him to feature in the finish again. RIPP (10) has exotic claims off a win from a similar barrier here two back.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 3YO COLTS AND GELDINGS - SEMI-FINAL 2 Boom colt LOUCASSO (8) made it three from three at this circuit and distance since joining Seaton Grima for this campaign when he took out a heat of this series by 2.3m last start. Draws wider but had enough speed to lead and win well from similar barriers in his other two outings since a long spell. Has been kept up to the mark with an easy trial win and is the one to beat. NOCTURNAL (5) was held up when runner-up here last week and had made it three wins on the trot with his fresh success at Newcastle prior. Runs into a smart one tonight but he is capable and should be close to his peak now. LEXY (1) came from the back row to beat a handy one when resuming at Bathurst. The ace draw can see him competitive. UPTOWN CHANCE (10) cops a wide draw but is worth including after winning two of his last three outings, one of them at this circuit and distance.

NUTRIEN EQUINE NSW BREEDERS CHALLENGE 4YO ENTIRES AND GELDINGS - SEMI-FINAL 2 DOUBLE LOU (8) makes his first appearance since July's Rising Sun but he was readied for this with two strong trials. Draws wide but he flies fresh with three wins and a placing from four attempts and his strike rate at this circuit and distance is encouraging. SINALOA (5) took on some handy rivals when midfield in a Listed FFA race last week. Fitter for that and is better placed against his own age group. HEEZA MALTEEZA (3) hasn't raced since he won here in March but should be ready to go off a couple of trials and has won three of five previous first-up attempts. Draws for a good return. WICKED WIZARD (2) led from much wider to place last week and is suited coming back to the mile having won here the last two times he raced over the distance. Has the speed to take advantage of a low draw. BETTORLIGHTEM UP (7) faded after working last start but won three of his previous four so is capable of better.

PRYDE'S EASIFEED PACE I GOT CHILLS (3) was a beaten favourite last start but he had the outside barrier and locked wheels so was far from disgraced when beaten 5m. Led to win from this barrier prior, part of a string of wins and placings he had put together at this circuit and distance. The draw gives him the chance to return to the winners' list. The same could be said for BUZZ BOMB (2) who drew wide and raced parked but fought well to go under narrowly last time. Led from this barrier to win at this circuit and distance prior, albeit in a lower-graded race. He has the speed to take advantage of the draw and make an impact again. VITE MONET (8) cops a wide barrier but has been tackling stronger company of late. Won the last time he raced in this grade so is better placed. ACTION MAJOR (1) has won two of three starts so far this time in, the latest from this barrier. Stronger here but he can be competitive. BEST BETS:
#5 Yottie – Classy gelding who can maintain his perfect record this time in.
